question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

__A medicine to counteract the effect of another medicine__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Antidote**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Antidote"** refers to a medicine or substance that counteracts the effects of poison or another harmful substance. (प्रतिविष)

 
 
• **Example:** Doctors administered an antidote to reverse the effects of the snake venom.
 
 
 
• It can also metaphorically refer to anything that counteracts or neutralizes an unpleasant feeling or situation. (प्रतिकारक)
 
 
• **Example:** Laughter is often considered an antidote to stress and sadness.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word is **"Antidote"**, as it directly addresses the phrase "A medicine to counteract the effect of another medicine."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Antidote**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Alimony** (भरण-पोषण): Financial support paid to a spouse after divorce or separation.

 
 
• **Example:** The court ordered him to pay alimony to his ex-wife after their divorce.
 
 
 
• **Antibiotic** (प्रतिजैविक): A medicine that inhibits the growth of or destroys microorganisms.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the bacterial infection.
 
 
 
• **Anticoagulant** (रक्त पतला करने वाली दवा): A substance that prevents blood clotting.
 
 
• **Example:** Patients with heart conditions are often prescribed anticoagulants to prevent blood clots.
